summary: Teck Resources Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, attaching a press release dated June 22, 2026, announcing the appointment of Edwin Shadeo as Acting Vice President, Investor Relations and Treasurer, effective immediately, succeeding Emma Chapman who is leaving for new professional opportunities. Mr. Shadeo has been with Teck since 2005 and has held various senior roles. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor names are mentioned. The filing is a routine transition announcement, not a forced departure. What to watch: ongoing senior management stability in a leading resource company.
